title: TypeSafe
line: Ask for separate structured judgments in one request.

beats.caption: You give the agent two questions about a check.
TypeSafe returns a probability for each question.
beats.label: pi-typesafe

beats.caption: The agent identifies what still needs a real check.

takeaway.title: Use the judgment to choose a check
takeaway.line: Keep each question separate and verify the behavior directly.

notes: The local fixture returns scripted probabilities through the normal TypeSafe client.

title.text: A structured judgment can help you decide what to verify when the question has more than one part.

scene.text: In this scripted example, TypeSafe returns two probabilities from one request. The proposed command passes the flag, and a separate question considers the default greeting.

takeaway.text: Use those answers to decide what to test next. Run both cases before you rely on the result.
